headline: Cricut unveils new all-in-one sticker-making machines
summary: Cricut has announced the StickerPix Print plus Cut and StickerPix Print, new compact machines that print, cut and laminate stickers. Designed as all-in-one solutions for turning photos into pre-cut stickers, they are among the smallest machines in Cricut's current lineup.
